thread:
ravi: quick follow-up from the chat-stream postmortem. summary: timeout spikes + duplicate partials during short network flaps. want owners for SDK backoff, handshake dedupe, metrics, canary.

emily: I can own metrics and alerts. need a metric for partial_emitted and stream_finalized, plus alert when partials > finals by >5 in 5m. dashboard PR target 2026-04-05.

nate: taking SDK backoff. plan: jittered exponential, cap retries to 4, add resume_quiet flag default true. PR by 2026-04-09. sample: delay = min(4000, 100*2**attempt)*(1+rand()*0.25).

ke: I'll do handshake idempotency server-side. propose handshake_nonce stored in short TTL store (redis ttl 4s) with local LRU fallback. design note by 2026-04-02, PR by 2026-04-12.

ops: I'll run recurrence scan for last 90 days and tag customers with >0 unfinalized sessions as RD-4304. output attached to ticket. schedule weekly digest x4 starting 2026-04-01.

qa-bot: Canary checklist needed: 1) run flaky-harness simulating socket flaps 2) ensure no session shows >1 partial without finalized in 30s 3) check resume.attempt logs per session. Can run verify by 2026-04-15.

emily: converting to tickets:
- RD-4300 nate: SDK backoff + resume_quiet (PR 2026-04-09)
- RD-4301 ke: handshake dedupe design+server change (design 2026-04-02, PR 2026-04-12)
- RD-4302 emily: metrics+alerts+dashboards (PR 2026-04-05)
- RD-4303 qa-bot/ops: canary + QA harness run (verify 2026-04-15)
- RD-4304 ops: recurrence scan + customer tagging + weekly digest x4 (start 2026-04-01)

ravi: please add verification steps in each ticket and update when PRs merge. reconvene 2026-04-17 14:00 UTC for verification sync. tag @nate @ke @emily @ops.

oncall-bot: incident tag applied: "chat-resume-flap-2026-03"; followups RD-4300..RD-4304 created.
